text:
Terrible experience. We came based on reviews, bringing my mother for a tooth extraction. Upon arrival, we informed the counter that my mother needed a tooth extraction. They asked if we had a prior history there, which we said no. They had us fill out my mother's medical history form. We waited from 1:10 PM with my mother until 2:00 PM when someone informed us that we were there for our scheduled appointment. Then they called the patients with appointments. I understand that appointments should be prioritized, but why weren't we informed when we arrived whether we were comfortable waiting? The doctor had an appointment at 2:00 PM. If they had informed us, we could have decided whether to wait or not, and planned whether we should go elsewhere. And that's not all; when we asked about the appointments, they didn't apologize or offer any explanation. They just walked away into the treatment room.
#You need to know what time your appointments are.
#You should inform walk-in patients, not make them wait for an hour without telling them when they will be treated. When asked, they just walked away.
The patients with appointments were called in at 2:10 PM.

I understand that appointments are required.

But why weren't we informed? We wouldn't have waited for an hour.
